steps.eval: (()=>{const R=window.__roadcraft;const s=R.surface;const sc=R.scene();const o={nature:R.doc.nature,surfaceKeys:s?Object.keys(s).slice(0,50):null,surfaceType:typeof s,sceneKeys:Object.keys(sc).slice(0,80)};try{const e=s&&s.ecology&&s.ecology();if(e){const m=(a)=>{let t=0;for(const v of a)t+=v;return t/a.length};o.eco={side:e.side,canopy:m(e.canopy),trees:m(e.trees),emergent:m(e.emergent)}}}catch(x){o.err=String(x)}return JSON.stringify(o)})()
